installed_sdk_audit: LocalParticipant.handleTrackEnded automatically reacquires library-created nonmuted microphones, including default-device fallback; LocalTrack.restart rebuilds the processor then replaces sender media without calling public participant.createTracks/publishTrack. Adding another ended→refresh owner would race it.

Public LocalAudioTrack(rawSource,constraints,true) establishes user-provided ownership before publication; actual installed SDK handleTrackEnded then mutes without restart or another GUM call. replaceTrack ownership cannot safely substitute before publish because its public method requires an existing sender.

Owned capture preserves SDK voiceIsolation:true/default-device semantics and existing AEC/AGC/NS/channel-count profile settings. Missing selected input does not silently fall back; explicit Use default action changes only the device-local preference.
contract: One exact raw source is owned by the shared microphone controller; stale GUM and processor results are stopped before publication. Auth owner/generation and guild channel/join-generation loss retire known pending raw immediately, without waiting for model preparation.

Exact-LocalParticipant admission lease is fail-closed when absent. Initial worker owner ACK opens it; key/layout/reconnect/auth/cleanup close synchronously and notify the controller to stop known raw preparation. Re-registering first retires the previous guard. Old lease close/retire or expected-controller cleanup cannot stop a replacement.

Persistent group session authority is checked in admission, raw capture and recovery actions; metadata retirement synchronously closes exact participant capture and owned playback before React unmount. The metadata store never holds a Room.

Raw ended is observed before processing and checked after awaited preparation; even an ended candidate without a usable publication cannot become active. Failures immediately silence/mute and latch; refresh/reconnect/render retry cannot silently reacquire. Rejected mute promises are handled.

Guild failure survives controller/rekey/render replacement keyed auth/channel/join generation; group failure survives rekey and render-boundary retry keyed stable logical callSessionNonce. Fresh runtime control nonces remain separate. Only explicit microphone recovery/new logical call clears failure; exact logical retirement/auth clears its own records.

Retry and Use default are explicit, fenced by current auth/channel/join/mount/admission/session before device-preference changes. Muted/deafened/PTT retry does not open capture; a subsequent authorized enable/PTT action is required.

Main and group effective mic indicators reflect capture failure while manual intent remains separate. Capture view activation/update/release use an exact mount nonce, preventing old status from replacing or clearing a newer call.
